_comment_step_m: Distance in metres of each discrete moveTo step in burst gait. Too small and the walk engine spends the whole move in its weight-shift preamble without stepping.
_comment_burst_gait: Short walk bursts with settle pauses. Needed only by the robot with BodyId ALDR1312N090344, whose roll diverges until it topples. Leave false on a healthy robot.
_comment_walk_arms: Arm swing while walking. Normally true - swinging arms help NAO balance. Set false only as an experiment, to remove arm motion as a variable.
_comment_voice: Acapela voice shape, applied to everything the robot says. voice_vct is vocal tract length 50-150 (100 = stock NAO, lower = deeper and bigger-sounding); voice_rspd is relative speed 60-140. Set from the Speech & Voice card with Save.
_comment_torso_wy: Torso pitch trim in radians, limit +-0.122. This robot stands ~9 deg forward-leaning (measured tiltY +0.164), which eats its forward margin. Negative pitches the torso back. Less negative if it starts falling backward instead.
